$comment: A minor release of one buying layer, as a module would ship it: buying/pricing 1.0 -> 1.1. It adds one optional property to the cpp pricing option, the spot length its fixed_price is quoted for. Each patch must touch a file the layer owns, and the additive check must pass. scripts/module-release.mjs runs it on a scratch copy of this example (npm run release:pricing); the example itself stays at 1.0. `refused` is not part of the release: the same field made required, which the additive check refuses.

value.description: The spot length, in seconds, that fixed_price is quoted for. The seller indexes other lengths from it.
